summary.en: Heiji tells Conan that he met a better detective than Conan during middle school and reminisces about the case three years ago. At Yamagata Zao Onsen Ski Resort, an actor named Shohei Minowa is murdered in the same fashion as his old stunt performer, Jiro Mizugami, who was murdered four years ago at the same resort.

victims.name: Jiro Mizugami
victims.causeOfDeath: Gunshot wound on the right temple

victims.name: Shohei Minowa
